dispute_loss_account_id.description: The expense account a lost dispute's draft journal writes its money off to, such as 5045 Dispute losses; left out, no draft can be prepared.

disputes_account_id.description: A chart account, not a money account, a disputed amount waits in, such as 1055; left out, a dispute waits for a person.

fee_account_id.description: The expense chart account fees post to, such as 5040.

payout_account_id.description: The money account payouts land in, in the same currency; left out, a payout waits for a person.

revenue_account_id.description: The revenue chart account a Model B provider's invoices book to, such as 4010 Subscription revenue; left out, a mirrored invoice waits for a person (FR-PSP-03).
